description: API gateway. FastAPI port 8787. Single entry point that proxies to all ZO-SENTINEL APIs. Routes: /assess/* -> registry_api:8781, /search/* -> search_api:8782, /submit/* -> approval_workflow:8780, /dashboard/* -> dashboard_api:8783, /bulk/* -> bulk_assess_api:8784, /compare/* -> comparison_api:8785. Adds rate limiting via RateLimiter middleware. Adds X-Sentinel-Version header. Adds request logging to mesh_events. GET /gateway/health checks all downstream /health endpoints. Daemon uvicorn port 8787. Heartbeat.
